cues: A candidate who starts writing the moment the topic is chosen produces four paragraphs that say the same thing four times.
A candidate who spends four minutes on a plan produces four paragraphs that each move the argument one step further.
And four hundred careful words beat six hundred careless ones, because the language mark is a mark for accuracy, not for quantity.
